title: Preserve assertion checks in historical replay children
body:
Inherited `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1` or `2` made the direct historical replay CLI print `PASS_HISTORICAL_CHECK` despite deliberate direct, nested and later-unittest assertion failures. Remove only that variable from a copied child environment, preserving checks in descendants and retaining the command arguments and authenticated historical overlays.

Four new real-process tests run the actual CLI in a tiny committed Git fixture. They cover those failures, passing replay with preserved environment and historical bytes, unchanged live files, and rejection of tracked-artifact mutation. Running the final tests with the original launcher gives eight expected failing subtests; the artifact-mutation control still passes.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Git 2.53.0:

```sh
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -v
PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2 python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -v
python3.14 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -v
PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2 python3.14 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -v
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_isolated_test_runner.py -v
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
```

All four historical-test runs pass 17 tests each (CPython 3.12.14 / 3.14.7), including authentication of every configured frozen replacement. All five adjacent runner tests pass.

Broader-check limitation: `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2 python3.12 -B scripts/replay_historical_check.py skip-clones-tests` fails at the existing `Pinned inherited source changed: scripts/partial_swap/shared.py` guard. The unchanged original main launcher, with ROOT/INPUTS pointed at the same checkout and run without optimization, fails identically. Eight WholeChainClone tests pass in each run; certificate-class setup fails. This separate pin is not changed. Linux/Windows execution, C++ execution and complete selected cold replay remain unrun.

Task card / provenance:

- `portable-replay`, scope **refined** to one direct launcher's inherited optimization boundary. Chooser nonce `2fed28e221ce4c7d2c68df4806a2bcf1`, priority revision 5. Domain: levels 1/2, direct/nested/later commands and positive/mutation controls. Stop after this one failure-propagation repair.
- Start: canonical main `7788b59946ebf3803dc38b6a19b47b4acb27f40b`. Submission base: `7981b35eb209d0808fe2066bd928cbeff94d00fe`; relevant guidance, selected record and both changed files were unchanged in the refresh.
- [Canonical investigation #2783](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2783). Submission overlap refresh: 721 open PRs (21:56:48 UTC) and 1,430 Discussion records (21:59:26 UTC), complete pagination and no warnings; the latest eight Discussion bodies were also checked. Metadata search is not a novelty guarantee.
- Credit Dennis's historical overlay and retained authors, cbethin/PR1299's registered-replay protection, woklerx/PR1852's isolated-runner protection and PR2495's parallel-entry repair (`e3b32c0964e2764310f8cf56b141b70c3160c283`). This applies their established pattern to another unprotected launcher.
- PR2734 (`c8cbad04f38bec0b5d5381a4dd2b9808b8d417f2`) changes copy/hash materialization, a complementary scope. Neither pending PR is imported or required.
- Next useful check: independent Linux/Windows execution of these CLI regressions. No supplier, profile or kappa claim; frozen evidence and the selected frontier are unchanged.

Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
